title: 第3269章 夜探厂区第3268章 夺舍与反杀
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
在灵气不足的情况下，修士为了修炼，什么事情都干得出来。
秦伏天在那人的记忆中看到过，龙婆谷有专门在战场上、在贫民窟中，吸收煞气、怨气的人，用来满足鬼修的修炼条件。
人有七情六欲，在满足不了自身欲望的情况下，总会产生痛苦和怨怼。
凡人聚集的场所，如果还涉及冤魂之类的血案，融合在一起的力量对鬼修的吸引力极大。
鬼修跟人类修士不同，他们舍弃了身体，只需要精炼灵魂，就算没有灵气也可以通过煞气和怨气修炼。
只不过，如果这些煞气和怨气是冲着他们来的，他们自身也会受到强烈的反噬。
“根据那人的记忆，这里的厂房内关押着与龙婆谷作对的敌人，敌人日夜被折磨，他们的怨气肯定不够纯粹。
但我总觉得，那些被我舍弃掉的力量，并不是因为不够纯粹，而是因为太松散了，就像不是同一个人身上的力量。”
秦伏天想着想着，突然皱起眉头，感觉不对。
这种功法无论怎么看，都不像是什么正经的传承功法，更像某些邪修用来养蛊的功法。
龙婆谷内，该不会有人在大量培养低等级的鬼修，打算跟秦伏天一样将这些鬼修的力量彻底吞没，弥补这个世界灵气不够的问题吧？
这种让人主动抛弃肉身，转修鬼法，再通过不断夺舍、吞噬他人灵魂来提升实力的功法，与残暴厮杀的魔族功法毫无区别。
赐下这套功法的人，绝对不怀好意！
秦伏天眼中闪过一丝杀意，他转头对苏晚棠道：“你先休息，今天晚上不会有人再过来打扰你，就算你在房间中发出什么动静，他们也不会怀疑，你不必担心。
我要出去一趟，看看这里的厂房，是否与我猜测的情况一致。”
苏晚棠心中一紧，小心地问道：“可你之前不是说，这里到处都是监控吗？”
秦伏天点了点头。
“白天是这样的，但晚上龙婆谷内有的一些见不得光的东西出没，为了避免被生活在这里的普通人察觉，至少今天晚上，他们不会打开监控。”
在这个世界上，修士与普通人是有壁垒的，所有的势力都在极力掩饰修士的存在，就连龙婆谷也不例外。
秦伏天不知道他们为什么要隐藏，但对于他来说，这样行动起来便利了不少。

简单交代了一下在房间中需要注意的事情，叮嘱苏晚棠有任何事情及时给他打电话，秦伏天推开窗户，悄无声息地下了楼。
从四层楼跳下来，对于普通人来说跟自杀没太大区别，可在风之法则的协助下，秦伏天轻松越下，没有发出一点动静。
他的身影快如残影，在寨子的阴影中快速闪过，元神之力弥漫而出，随时准备躲开巡逻的岗哨。
越过高耸的厂房围墙，秦伏天翻身进入里面。
此时夜色已深，这里的人基本上睡过去了，只有几只狼犬在精神地环视四周。
可感受到秦伏天身上的威压，本该负责警戒的狼犬，都乖巧地匍匐在地，口中发出讨好的哼唧，不敢有丝毫违背。
这是动物在面对比它位阶更高的生物时，最本能的反应。
“根据那人的记忆，厂区会将采集到的怨气，存入地下室的最深处。
每个星期，龙婆谷高层会派人过来收集一次，然后发放给其他鬼修。
content_en:
When spiritual energy is insufficient, monks can do anything in order to practice.
Qin Futian saw in that person's memory that there were people in Long Po Valley who specialized in absorbing evil spirits and resentment on the battlefield and in the slums to meet the cultivation conditions of ghost cultivators.
People have seven emotions and six desires, and when they cannot satisfy their own desires, they will always produce pain and resentment.
In a place where mortals gather, if there are murder cases involving wronged souls, the combined power will be extremely attractive to ghost cultivators.
Ghost cultivators are different from human monks. They abandon their bodies and only need to refine their souls. Even if they don't have aura, they can still cultivate through evil spirits and resentment.
However, if these evil spirits and resentments are directed at them, they themselves will also suffer strong backlash.
"According to that person's memory, the enemies who opposed Luang Phor Gu were imprisoned in the factory here. The enemies were tortured day and night, and their grievances were definitely not pure enough.
But I always feel that the powers that I discarded are not because they are not pure enough, but because they are too loose, as if they are not the powers of the same person. "
Qin Futian thought about it and suddenly frowned, feeling something was wrong.
No matter how you look at it, this kind of technique does not look like a serious inherited technique, but more like a technique used by some evil cultivators to cultivate poison.
Is there someone in Long Po Valley who is cultivating a large number of low-level ghost cultivators, intending to completely engulf the power of these ghost cultivators like Qin Futian to make up for the lack of spiritual energy in this world?
This kind of technique that allows people to voluntarily abandon their physical bodies, turn to ghost techniques, and then increase their strength by constantly seizing bodies and devouring other people's souls is no different from the brutal fighting techniques of demons.
The person who gave this set of skills definitely has bad intentions!
A trace of killing intent flashed in Qin Futian's eyes. He turned to Su Wantang and said, "You should rest first. No one will come to disturb you again tonight. Even if you make any noise in the room, they will not suspect it. You don't have to worry.
I'm going to go out and see if the factory here is consistent with what I guessed. "
Su Wantang's heart tightened and she asked carefully: "But didn't you say before that there are surveillance cameras everywhere?"
Qin Futian nodded.
"It is like this during the day, but at night there are some shady things in Luang Phor Valley. In order to avoid being noticed by ordinary people living here, at least tonight, they will not turn on the surveillance."
In this world, there are barriers between monks and ordinary people. All forces are trying their best to conceal the existence of monks, even Luang Phor Valley is no exception.
Qin Futian didn't know why they wanted to hide, but for him, it was much easier to move like this.
After briefly explaining what needed to be paid attention to in the room, and telling Su Wantang to call him in time if anything happened, Qin Futian opened the window and quietly went downstairs.
Jumping down from the fourth floor is not much different from committing suicide for ordinary people, but with the help of the Law of Wind, Qin Futian jumped down easily without making any sound.
His figure was as fast as an afterimage, flashing through the shadows of the village. The power of his soul filled the air, ready to evade the patrolling sentry at any time.
After crossing the towering factory wall, Qin Futian turned over and entered.
It was already dark at this time, and most of the people here had fallen asleep. Only a few wolfhounds were looking around energetically.
But feeling the pressure from Qin Futian, the wolf dogs that were supposed to be on guard all crouched on the ground obediently, grunting in a flattering manner, not daring to disobey him in the slightest.
This is the most instinctive reaction of an animal when faced with a creature of higher rank than itself.
“According to that person’s memory, the factory will store the collected resentment in the deepest part of the basement.
Every week, the senior officials of Luang Phor Valley will send someone to collect them once and then distribute them to other ghost cultivators.
